::: {#def-no-spillover .theorem}
## No contagion

No variable in a given [observational unit](#def-observational-unit) is a parent of an [equivalent](#def-equivalence) variable in another unit, i.e. no element of a covariate influences another element of the same covariate.

$$
X\notin \mathbf{Pa}(X')\quad \forall\, X\sim X',\ X\in \mathscr O_i,\ X'\in \mathscr O_j,\ i\ne j.
$$
:::
